policy: One shared Legends artist/credit and P/T profile. Font, placement, width and shadow selected on 34 material-balanced training printings (15 creatures), then measured on 36 reserved printings (20 creatures). A subsequent weight study reused that held group; it is not new independent validation. All 70 actual renderer crops exactly reproduce the fitted candidates. No per-printing renderer adjustments. These are local two-polarity text-edge objectives, not whole-card scores.
limitations: Artist names are supplied by the host; this profile does not infer scan-specific spelling.
The current full-card compliance metric excludes unverified legal credits from its ranked aggregate; local credit diagnostics are reported separately.
